instruction:
On the deployed training site at elegantfrontend.training, build a landing section that shows: (1) a free course preview with 3 sample lessons (UI/Server/State architecture terms + Agent Skills), (2) a 'Start Practicing' CTA linking to the practice dashboard, and (3) tier cards with pricing (synced per prop_9aa8e2f4). Use existing showcase content and terminology data. Verify by checking the page loads at / with course cards, practice link works, and tier cards display. Target: upvotes rise from 1 to ≥10 and satisfaction from 0.36 to ≥0.70 on next user panel.

The CEO approved this with a change; where it differs from the above, it wins: Have a pencil banner on top. Reduce the hero banner text that is readable

plan.problem: The task is to update the landing page at elegantfrontend.training with specific content blocks: a free course preview (3 lessons), a 'Start Practicing' CTA, and pricing tier cards synced via prop_9aa8e2f4. Additionally, two CEO-mandated overrides must be implemented: adding a pencil banner at the top and shortening the hero banner text for better readability. Success is measured by specific metrics in the user panel.
plan.approach: Use the training-site-landing-pages skill to implement all UI components, content integration, and branding adjustments in a single pass, then verify the requirements against the live site.

reflection: The landing page update task failed because the site build is broken due to a missing pricing-tiers.html include file and incomplete pricing data, causing all verification checks to fail. · keep: The plan structure was sound with clear implementation and verification steps. The approach of using the training-site-landing-pages skill was appropriate for the task scope. · change: Create the missing docs/_includes/pricing-tiers.html file before referencing it in layouts. Populate docs/_data/pricing.yml with required tier entries (free, monthly, annual, lifetime) to satisfy pricing sync checks. Ensure all required URL patterns (/courses/, /practice/, /pricing/) are present in the generated site. Re-run the full verification suite after fixing build errors instead of assuming completion.
